Name: Tetsu's Crush Indicator
Author: AITetsudol
Description:
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/Y9nx2DT6/description.png[/img]

[color=#D4D4D8]Getting tired of checking the Social Tab to see [b]who's [/b]marriage material in expansions like East Scarp, Ridgeside Village, and SDVE? Have so many custom NPCs installed that you can't keep track of them all? This mod makes it instantly clear who's romanceable and who isn't. [/color]

[b][color=#3c78d8]No Content Patcher Required![/color] [/b]Unlike most UI replacements, this mod is written entirely in C# and doesn't use Content Patcher. Because it doesn't edit the game's LooseSprites/Cursors.png file, it will never conflict with other UI mods (if there is any issues, let me know!). It seamlessly hides the vanilla jewel and draws the new heart over the top of whatever custom UI you currently have installed.

[size=4][font=Comic Sans MS][b][color=#ff0000]🌱 [/color][color=#6aa84f]Installation Instructions[/color][/b][/font][/size]
[list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url][/color][/*]
[*]Download [b]Crush Indicator[/b] and unzip it into your Stardew Valley\Mods folder[/*]
[/list][size=4][font=Comic Sans MS][b][color=#ff0000]🌾[/color][color=#6aa84f]Main Features[/color][/b][/font][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Changes the friendship jewel [img]https://i.postimg.cc/sfQQPhdN/jewelred.png[/img] into a heart [img]https://i.postimg.cc/h4zz8dW3/heartred.png[/img] for [b]Romanceable NPCs Only[/b] like in Story of Seasons/Harvest Moon.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Compatible with East Scarp, SDVE, Ridgeside Village, and custom NPCs! The mod checks the game's romanceable flag, so it works automatically.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Tons of Options: Choose from 3 built-in heart styles and 18 socket themes or remove the wooden socket completely.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#3c78d8][b]Completely Customizable[/b][/color][color=#d4d4d8]: Change the heart size scale, the pulse intensity, and the offsets. You can even move the icon around your screen in real-time using "Calibration Mode".[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Blank templates and custom config slots are included so you can easily add your own custom icons.[/color][/*]
[/list][size=4][font=Comic Sans MS][b][color=#ff0000]🫗🌱 [/color][color=#6aa84f]Requirements[/color][/b][/font][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Only requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url][/color][/*]
[*]Optional (but r[i]eally[/i] recommended): [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url][/*]
[/list]
[color=#8e7cc3][size=5][font=Comic Sans MS][b][img]https://i.postimg.cc/85KbkXxL/how-to-use.png[/img][/b][/font][/size][/color]

[size=4][font=Comic Sans MS]🌻[b][color=#6aa84f]Visual Settings[/color][/b][/font][/size]
Here is where you'll adjust the primary visuals. If you feel like things got messed up you can hover over the option and the tool tip will tell you what the defaults are.
[list]
[*]Heart Style: Exactly what it sounds like! It changes what the icon looks like and the colors it uses for relationship progression.[/*]
[*]Box Style (or [i]Socket[/i]): The little box that goes behind the heart icon. You can choose from various colors (or make your own) or disable it completely.[/*]
[*]Heart Scale: Adjusts the overall size of the icon.[/*]
[*]Pulse Intensity: Controls how intensely the heart "beats". You can even set it to 0 to make the icon completely static![/*]
[*]Note: You can edit these in-game via the Mod Config Menu, or by manually editing the config.json file in the CrushIndicator folder. The config file will generate automatically once you launch the game with the mod installed for the first time.[/*]
[/list][img]https://i.postimg.cc/3RVcybz1/visual-style.png[/img]

[b][size=4][font=Comic Sans MS]🪏[color=#6aa84f]Calibration Mode[/color][/font][/size][/b]
Using a custom UI mod? You can move the heart to fit perfectly.
[list=1]
[*]In the Mod Config Menu, turn on "Enable Calibration Mode" and save.[/*]
[*]Talk to any romanceable NPC.[/*]
[*]Use the Arrow Keys to nudge the heart into place (Hold Shift to move 10 pixels at a time!).[/*]
[*]The new offset is automatically saved to your config.[/*]
[/list][color=#cc4125][b]Note: Be sure to turn it off in the config menu when you're done![/b][/color]

[img width=600]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50713/50713-1786764712-2016295549.gif[/img]

[b][size=4][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#d4d4d8]🪴[/color][color=#6aa84f]Template[/color][/font][/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Go to this mod's [font=Courier New]assets [/font]folder to find the blank custom templates.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Open them in Paint or any graphics editor.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Draw your art and overwrite the file (keep the name exactly the same, ex. hearts_custom1.png).[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Select "Custom 1" in the Mod Config Menu to see your art in-game![/color][/*]
[/list][img width=600]https://i.postimg.cc/4dgGKytQ/templates.png[/img]
